cli.help.demo: show the interface offline with sample data

cli.help.list_languages: list the available languages and exit

session.login_failed: Login failed. Use a valid token for your own Discord account.
session.connection_failed: Connection failed ({name}). Check account access and connectivity.
http.no_details: No structured field details are available for this response.
http.partial: The destination may be partially modified; inspect it before retrying.
validate.unavailable: Server {id} is unavailable or your account is not a member.
validate.no_admin: Your account needs Administrator permission in destination server {id}.
validate.retained_not_admin: Your highest destination role must grant Administrator so it can be retained.
validate.role_hierarchy: Move your destination Administrator role above every other ordinary role.
validate.community: Use a destination with Community disabled; required Community channels cannot be deleted.
issue.settings_overwrites_item: Channels and categories with permission overwrites: {count}
issue.settings_overwrites_consequence: Create every channel without its allow/deny rules. Private channels can become visible; review destination permissions.
issue.settings_roles_item: Channels and categories with role overwrites: {count}
issue.settings_roles_reason: Your settings turn off copy.roles, so these roles will not exist in the destination.
issue.settings_roles_consequence: Skip every overwrite that refers to a source role. Missing allow/deny rules can change who can view or use these channels; review destination permissions.
issue.role_omission: Skip this role and its permission overwrites. Channels and categories affected: {count}. Other roles and channels will still be copied. Missing allow/deny rules can change who can view or use these channels; review destination permissions.
issue.capacity_reason: Copied roles plus retained destination roles exceed Discord's role limit.
issue.capacity_consequence: Copy the first {capacity} source roles in hierarchy order. Roles to skip, with their channel overwrites: {omitted}. Missing allow/deny rules can change channel access.
issue.category_reason: Source channel {channel} references a missing category.
issue.category_consequence: Create its channels without a category, preserving each channel's available permission overwrites. Review their access and organization.
issue.role_overwrite_reason: This managed or missing source role cannot be copied.
issue.member_consequence: Skip this member's overwrites on all copied channels and categories. Their destination access may differ.
issue.icon_reason: The source icon could not be downloaded.
issue.icon_consequence: Keep the current destination icon; continue copying the rest of the server.
issue.mapping_reason: This permission subject has no destination mapping; source metadata may have changed.
issue.mapping_consequence: Skip only this overwrite and copy the remaining channel settings. Missing allow/deny rules can change who can use the channel.
issue.remove_channel: Leave this destination channel/category in place and continue. The result may contain old channels or duplicate names.
issue.remove_role: Leave this destination role and its member assignments in place. Its permissions remain active and it still uses a role slot.
issue.everyone: Keep the destination's existing @everyone permissions and continue. This can change access across the entire destination; review its permissions.
issue.role_order: Keep the copied roles in their current order. Review the role hierarchy.
issue.create_category: Skip this category and create its child channels without a category, preserving each channel's available overwrites. Review channel access.
issue.parent_category_reason: Category ID {category} has no destination mapping.
issue.parent_category_consequence: Create channels belonging to this category without a category, preserving each channel's available overwrites. Review channel access.
issue.create_channel: Skip this channel; continue with the remaining channels.
issue.voice_slowmode: Leave slowmode off for this voice channel and continue.
issue.channel_order: Keep these channels in the order they were created and continue.
issue.identity: Skip the server name/icon update; keep the copied roles and channels.
